events.title: IronFlux is in Steam Next Fest: the free demo is live
events.summary: IronFlux is part of Steam Next Fest, October 19–26. The free demo is live right now, so this is the best week to try it. What's in the demo Basic Training: three missions that teach the controls, the economy and how to take a Monolith. Skirmish against the AI on hand-built maps or generated ones in nine terrain styles, for 2 to 8 commanders. Set teams, start positions, colours, army size and bot difficulty for each seat. events.title: IronFlux 0.1.19: New Training, a New Economy and Smarter Bots
events.summary: IronFlux 0.1.19 is out now for the full game, the Demo, the Playtest and the IronFlux Map Editor. events.title: IronFlux 0.1.15: Replies In Game, Replays That Keep Working, and Smarter Armies
events.summary: IronFlux 0.1.15 is out, bringing everything from 0.1.11 and 0.1.12 together with a new way to hear back from us about your reports. Here's what has changed since our last update. Talk to us from inside the game Replies to your reports: when we answer a problem report you sent (F8 or REPORT A PROBLEM), the main menu shows REPLY FROM THE IRONFLUX TEAM. events.title: IronFlux 0.1.10: Faster Battles, Cleaner Controls, a New Map Editor
events.summary: Commanders, two updates have landed since our last post. Here is what changed in 0.1.9 and 0.1.10. Big battles run smoother Late-game fights with thousands of units now run about three times faster. Four-player matches stay responsive when every army is at full strength. Every key does one thing P now only pauses. The Pyre moved to Space. Ctrl+B and Ctrl+V are only the blueprint keys. events.title: IronFlux Demo 0.1.5: Major Update, Available Until 1.0
events.summary: The IronFlux demo is now on version 0.1.5, the same build as the full game, with a lot of new things to try. The demo stays available until 1.0 Once it's out, the demo isn't going anywhere: it will stay available on Steam until IronFlux reaches 1.0, and it's updated alongside the full game as it grows.
